body: Learned 2026-11-13 03:45Z (Sol-edfd #1222, w-36d0): an acceptance evaluation of a committed-input item is refused before spawn unless the named root's HEAD has a CLASSIFIED Test or Build record. API 409 committed_input_no_eligible_run means there's no eligible run at HEAD. API 409 verification_record_unclassified_stages means the run was eligible but unclassified, e.g. `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --input commit -- node --version`. A node --version sighting gives eligible input and a named-root sighting, but NOT the classified record evaluations need. For Opus2's own integration items (combo73..83), the closure check in each named root must be a recognized test or build at the landed commit: vitest for UI combos (npm ci in ui, then focused --input commit -- node ui/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --root ui <file>), or a registered cargo test/check for Rust combos (Central slot). Don't rely on the node --version sightings for evaluation.
